post.description:
Creates a **manual dispatch** delivery order (`is_manual_dispatch=true`, `order_status=confirmed`) for phone/walk-in orders from the **Vendor POS** app. Requires **`manual_dispatch`** enabled on the restaurant (Business Setup toggle) or restaurant id listed in admin `manual_dispatch_restaurants`.

**Idempotency:** repeat calls with the same `idempotency_key` return the existing order summary (no duplicate jobs).

**Side effects (drivers):**
1. **FCM** — `order_request` push to all vehicle topics in the restaurant zone + zone-wide topic.
2. **Socket.IO** — event **`order_request`** on the same FCM topic rooms (drivers connected with delivery-man JWT). Request-tab clients should refetch `GET /delivery-man/orders/latest` on this event.
3. **`user_notifications`** — inbox row for each approved driver in the zone.

Mirrors legacy PHP `POST /vendor/dispatch/request-driver`.

tags.description: Account info and settings: GET /consumer/whoami, PUT /consumer/update-profile, DELETE /consumer/delete-account, PUT /consumer/update-firebase-token, PUT /consumer/update-zone, POST /consumer/update-interest, GET /consumer/suggested-foods.

tags.description: Wish list (PHP /api/v1/customer/wish-list). Favourite a food or a restaurant.

tags.name: Vendor Restaurant Setup
tags.description: Restaurant Web Panel **Config** (business setup): GET/PUT /vendor/restaurant/business-setup, open/close PUT /vendor/restaurant/active-status, toggles PUT /vendor/restaurant/setting-toggle, SEO PUT /vendor/restaurant/meta-data, hours POST/DELETE /vendor/restaurant/schedules. Bearer from POST /vendor/login.

tags.name: Vendor Orders (Web Panel & POS)
tags.description: Marketplace orders from consumer app (POST /consumer/order/place). Shared by Restaurant Web Panel and Vendor POS/kitchen app — same Bearer JWT from POST /vendor/login. Web Panel: SSE GET /vendor/orders/events for instant new-order alerts (no polling). Does not include in-store POS sales (order_type=pos). POS also receives FCM push type=new_order when configured. **Manual dispatch:** POST /vendor/dispatch/request-driver (phone order → zone drivers via FCM + Socket `order_request`).

tags.name: Delivery Man Auth
tags.description: POST /delivery-man/login, /register, /password/forgot, /password/verify-otp, PUT /password/reset, PUT /password/change. Approve pending drivers: `npm run approve-riders`.

tags.name: Delivery Man Profile
tags.description: GET /delivery-man/whoami, GET /profile, PUT /profile/status (online toggle). Bearer JWT required.

tags.name: Delivery Man Orders
tags.description: GET /orders/active, GET /orders/latest (pool), GET /orders/history (My Orders), PUT /orders/{id}/accept, PUT /orders/{id}/status. E2E: consumer place → vendor confirm → latest → accept → delivered (records earnings). Realtime: Socket.IO event **`order_request`** on FCM topic rooms — refetch GET /orders/latest when on the request tab (includes POS manual dispatch).

tags.name: Admin Zones
tags.description: Delivery zones (PostGIS polygons). Admin JWT. Assign restaurants via PUT /admin/zones/restaurant/{restaurantId}.

tags.name: Consumer Zones
tags.description: Zone resolve and map. **Frontend flow:** GET /consumer/config/zone-id → parse zone_id → query zone_id on GET /consumer/restaurants/nearby (with lat/lng), /popular, /all, GET /consumer/home-slider, GET /consumer/categories (What's on your mind), favourites.

tags.name: Delivery Man Home
tags.description: GET /delivery-man/home — today / week / month order counts + today's earning.

tags.name: Delivery Man Earnings
tags.description: GET /delivery-man/earnings — wallet summary, period totals, paginated history with full order + items.

tags.name: Delivery Man Notifications
tags.description: GET /delivery-man/notifications, DELETE /notifications/{id}, PUT /fcm-token. Paginated inbox + FCM device token.

tags.name: Vendor Notifications
tags.description: GET /vendor/notifications, DELETE /notifications/{id}. New-order and admin broadcasts.

tags.name: Consumer Notifications
tags.description: GET /consumer/notifications, DELETE /notifications/{id}. Use zoneId header or zone_id query.
